Palvolve_00_About.Title: Palvolve: Evolution
Palvolve_00_About.Description:
Your captured Pals can evolve into related forms. A Pengullet becomes a Penking, a Jormuntide becomes a Jormuntide Ignis.

An evolution keeps the Pal you raised. Level, passive skills, learned moves, IVs, souls, condenser rank and trust all carry over. What changes is the species, and with it the base stats, the element and the work suitability.

To evolve, summon the Pal, hold the Pal command wheel key (4 by default) and pick Evolve. The wheel lists every form that Pal can reach and names what is still missing: a level, a condition, or materials. Evolution Stones and Adaptation Stones are crafted at the Pal Alchemy Workbench.

Which evolutions exist is not fixed. They come from the configuration the world runs on, so a server can use a completely different tree than your single player world. The next pages show the tree that is loaded right now.

One quirk to know: the work suitability icons keep showing the old species until you log out and back in. The save is already correct.
